file_insights.changes_summary: Added Location-related interfaces for multi-location support

patterns_discovered: Consistent interface naming convention (Location, LocationInsert, LocationUpdate)
Comprehensive field coverage for location data
Optional fields marked with '?' for flexible data entry
Detailed type annotations for each field
Inclusion of timestamps and boolean flags
gotchas_discovered: Requires unique slug within an organization
Implicit requirement for organization_id in location creation
recommendations: Consider adding validation logic for slug uniqueness
Implement default values for optional boolean fields like is_active
Create helper functions for slug generation
Add comprehensive documentation for each interface's purpose and constraints
